errors.message: The band's high edge is 6000 Hz, over 0.45 times the requested rate (5760 Hz); raise the rate or lower the band.
The drive ceiling is 1.5 V, over the drive row's range of 1 V; lower the ceiling or raise the row's range.
At 1 dB/s the stop takes 40 s, longer than the 30 s the service waits for a stop; raise the drive slew above 1.333 dB/s.
